hypothesis: A continuous pre-tournament log-rank prior improves a trained match-winner model beyond historical win/loss and game-share ratings.
previous: EXP-20261027-07 remains rejected; new ranking signal was not part of that candidate. Current live ranking use selects opponent buckets, not a direct continuous strength prior.
scope: Same frozen 2020-25 raw Sackmann corpus and 21-day delay; 2025 confirmation already read for EXP07 and earlier work, therefore ALL results are dev/research, not untouched holdout. No 2026/live holdout access.
rank_feature: canonical player A vs B: log(rank_B/rank_A), both positive integers <=10000. Missing either -> 0 (neutral), missing coverage explicitly reported. Direct raw source key + winner/loser/date must match. Ranks are source pre-tournament fields, original publication clocks not verified, retain FLAG.
training: No intercept; ridge=1; no scaler/hyperparameter search. Same 5 expanding dev folds and confirmation 2025H2 as protocol.json. Fit using labels available strictly before fold start.
decision: Add rank only if fitted binary+rank improves BOTH LL/Brier vs fitted binary in ALL 5 dev folds; combined only if improves both metrics vs binary+games and binary+rank in all 5. Simpler accepted candidate takes precedence; no argmax. Fix candidates before reading outcomes. Open confirmation only for dev-eligible arms; paired CI vs direct control must exclude zero for both metrics and ATP/WTA nonworsening. NO PROMOTION even on pass: not fresh PIT holdout nor verified pre-match executable prices.
stop: No threshold/window/corpus edits, no additional combinations after outcomes. Preserve rejected arms off main.
